features: Faster baseline combat pace for players, pets, and mobs (+25% player baseline Haste, +25 Store TP, +20 Regain, +15 Fast Cast; +12-25% mob Haste + Regain/Store TP).

Progressive Lv 1-75 boss-like combat modifiers on all normal mobs and NMs (scaling across Spec tiers at Lv 10/30/50/70+), plus level-gap scaling (EM-IT soloable with a good spec but tougher; IT++ at +8 levels is the wall) and anti-one-shot breath/suicide move normalization.
Greatly increased EXP per kill (higher per-monster caps, extended 3x chain timers, boosted chain multipliers, and extra kill multipliers) to compensate for longer, boss-like fights.

Level 99 QoL unlocks (Mog Sack/Case/Safe 2 & Wardrobes 1-8 resized to 80 slots, all 9 Rhapsodies of Vana'diel key items for 5 Trusts + bonuses, all 22 standard jobs unlocked, and all combat/magic skills auto-capped).
BiS Lv.1 All-Jobs Starter Kit (29 items) auto-granted on new characters and existing logins via `!starterkit`.
Lv.1 Weapons Shop (`!weapons`, `!startershop`, & city Starter Weapons Moogles) with Featured BiS/HQ page + 5 full catalog pages (263 weapons).

baselinePlayerPace.desc: Brisk combat speed right from Level 1 without needing endgame Haste gear first.
Faster TP generation on every melee and ranged swing.
Passive TP regeneration while engaged in battle.
Snappier spell casting and shorter recasts across all jobs.

petCombatPace.desc: Applied automatically to all player pets, avatars, automatons, and companions.

Tactical Breach (Lv10, 20s CD, 10s, Enemy 15y): +12/18/24/30% Skillchain DMG, +8/12/16/20% Magic Burst & Crit DMG, +100/150/200/250 TP on SC close.
Formation: Bulwark (Lv10, 25s CD, 15s, Party 10y): Stacking Phalanx (8 + 0.45*Lv), +5/10/15/20 MDEF, +12/18/25/35 Status Resist, +30/50/75/100% Knockback Resist.
Battle Cadence (Lv10, 20s CD, 12s, Party 10y): +12/18/24/30 Subtle Blow (+0/0/5/10 SB II), +10/15/22/30 Conserve TP, +8/12/16/20% Cure Rcvd.
Rallying Horn (Lv10, 45s CD, 12s, Party 12y): Cleanses Slow/Bind (Lv30+ Weight/Para; Lv50+ DEF/MDEF Down; Lv70+ Atk/Acc Down), +5/7/9/12% HP, +75/125/175/250 TP, +8/10/12/15% Move Speed.

crystals.name: Spartan
crystals.description: Frontline phalanx tank (Lv10+): requires a Polearm paired with a Size-1 Buckler (or an empty SUB for a virtual Aspis Buckler) to unlock Spear-Wall Guard/Block, Spartan's Grit damage-to-barrier conversion, and charge-based Melee & Spell Brace deflection.

Spartan's Grit: taking damage or blocking grants +1 Grit (max 5). Any Polearm WS consumes all Grit for an Iron Resolve barrier (4/5/6/7% Max HP per stack, cap 35%/40%), heavy enmity, and Maim.
Impaling Thrust (Lv10, 20s CD, Enemy 8y, Polearm): Stun 2s (+5s Silence mid-cast), Maim, +2 Grit (+4 during Defender / Mighty Strikes).
Phalanx Ward (Lv10, 35s CD, 2 Grit, Self 12s, Polearm): +15/22/30/38% Block, -10/12/15/18% DT, +25/35/45/55 Enmity, Knockback Immunity, arms a Heavy Brace.
Spear-Wall Brace: Defender (15s CD) arms a Light Brace (-25% next hit, +1 Grit, Off-Balance). Heavy Brace: -50% next hit, Grit to 5, 2s Stun, Exposed Guard (+4s Silence vs spells).
Tactical Instinct: warns when your target crosses 750 TP or begins casting.
Tier 6 Tank: -60% Physical & Magical Damage Dealt, no negative ATTP/RATTP/WSD penalties.
WAR JAs: Warcry (party -8% DMG, +20 self Enmity, Adrenaline Surge below 50% HP), Provoke (Adrenaline Surge below 50% HP), Mighty Strikes (-25% DT, +50 Enmity, instant 5 Grit).

Staff Riposte (w/ Staff): +12% Parry Rate; Parrying heals 2% Max HP, grants +75 TP, +Enmity, and strikes back. Evading grants 1.5% Max HP, +50 TP, +Enmity, and deals an Evasive Counter.
Iron Counterstance (Lv10, 120s CD): +30% Counter, +20 Counter DMG, -10% DT, +20 Enmity, with no DEF halving penalty.

Tank JAs: Dodge (60s, +25 EVA, +15% EVA, +12% Parry, +15 Enmity, +25% Evasive Counter DMG), Focus (+15% Counter, +15 Parry, +10 Counter DMG), Boost (+15 Enmity, +50 TP), Chi Blast (heavy Enmity + Acc Down), Chakra (+50% heal, Regen, cleanses Slow/Silence), Perfect Counter (45s CD, +25 Counter DMG, +25 Enmity, 5% heal), Mantra (party -5% DT), Inner Strength (60s, -25% DT, +20% EVA%, +30 Counter DMG, +50 Enmity).

commands.summary: Backup menu to equip a Size-1 Buckler in the Sub slot alongside a
Party-size-aware leveling & Lv.75 merit camp warp menu for OverlordsXI.
Controls Scholar's Eos (Medic) or Titania (Sage) faerie companion.
Auto-grants and equips a full 16-slot level-appropriate gear loadout tailored to your Job, active Crystal Spec, Role, and Weapon.
Silent Ashita v4 Universal Soul HUD sync command.
Interactive Job Crystal / Soul Spec selector menu, CLI inspector, and Ashita v4 [OXSPEC] sync.
Spec-adaptive Weaponskill Talent Tree builder (4 Tiers, 56 pts per WS, Tier-1 WS unlock, Skillchain selector) & Ashita v4 0x1FD binary /talents UI bridge.
usage: !talent add <ws_key_or_id> <node_key> (use !talent info <ws> to see node keys)

commands.summary: Opens the 263-weapon Lv.1 Starter Shop anywhere, re-grants the 29-item BiS Lv.1 Starter Kit, or inspects combat scaling.

patches.title: Allow Eos Custom Pet And Effect Ids
patches.description: raises `MAX_PETID` from `128` to `129` and `MAX_EFFECTID` from `814` to `815`.

patches.title: Eos Deterministic Level And Subjob
patches.description: makes Eos spawn at the master's level and correctly initializes her SCH main job / SMN subjob levels.

patches.title: Unlock All Player Weaponskills
patches.description: unlocks all implemented player weaponskills at level 1 for any job wielding that weapon type (excluding NPC/event/unimplemented WSes).

patches.title: Dynamic Ws Skillchain Traits
patches.description: reads per-cast `OX_WS_SC1..3` localVars inside `CCharEntity::OnWeaponSkillFinished` so talent-upgraded skillchain properties apply dynamically on each weaponskill.

patches.title: Clear Ws Skillchains Dynamically
patches.description: clears/overrides WS skillchain slots cleanly when `OX_WS_SC_SET` is present.

patches.title: Eos Status Effect Params
patches.description: configures status effect IDs `789` (stackable Eos Regen) and `814` (hidden faerie Refresh/buff carrier) in C++.

patches.title: Spec Ability Unlocks
patches.description: hooks `xi.overlords.spec.getExtraAbilities` into `charutils::BuildingCharAbilityTable` (so crystal-gated JAs like **Call Eos**, **Call Titania**, Commander WAR's **Warcry** / custom JAs, and Sensei MNK's **Counterstance** remain hidden until unlocked at Lv.10+) and syncs ability recasts in `recalculateAbilitiesTable()`.

patches.title: Titania Sage Pet
patches.description: raises `MAX_PETID` to `130` (`PETID_FAERIE_TITANIA = 129`) and deterministically spawns Titania at the master's level with `BLM` main job and `RDM` subjob.

patches.title: Crystal Socket Packets
patches.description: adds custom packets `0x11F` (`GP_CLI_COMMAND_CRYSTAL_SOCKET`, C2S) and `0x1FF` (`GP_SERV_COMMAND_CRYSTAL_COLLECTION` `CRYS` / `GP_SERV_COMMAND_CRYSTAL_CATALOG` `CRYC`, S2C) backed by `xi.overlords.spec` for the Ashita v4 `crystalsocket` Equipment UI.

patches.title: Spec Trait Sync And Unlocks
patches.description: expands `MAX_TRAIT_ID` / `CCharEntity::m_TraitList` to `256` (`32` bytes matching `GP_SERV_COMMAND_COMMAND_DATA`), overrides `CCharEntity::hasTrait`, refreshes spec crystal mods/listeners/UI on every `charutils::BuildingCharTraitsTable` rebuild (job change, subjob change, level change, level sync), and injects crystal-gated custom Job Traits (`xi.overlords.spec.getExtraTraits`) directly into the Traits menu.

patches.title: Commander Status Effects
patches.description: raises `MAX_EFFECTID` to `832` and configures custom status effect IDs `815`â€“`826` (`commander_breach`, `commander_bulwark`, `commander_cadence`, `commander_regroup`, `berserker_bloodlust`, `gladiator_bastion`, `inquisitor_battuta`, `inquisitor_aegis`, `inquisitor_converge`, `spellblade_overcharge`, `lifebinder_font`, `lifebinder_sanctuary`).

patches.title: Dot Damage Log
patches.description: attributes player/pet/trust DoT ticks on mobs (`Dia`, `Bio`, `Poison`, `Burn`/`Frost`/`Choke`/`Rasp`/`Shock`/`Drown`, `Requiem`, `Kaustra`, `Geo-Poison`, `Helix`) and emits parser-friendly `0x017` `MESSAGE_SYSTEM_3` combat log lines (`"<Caster>'s <Effect> deals <Amount> point(s) of damage to <Mob>."`).

patches.title: Throwing Weaponskills
patches.description: Registers the 12 custom Dancer Throwing weaponskills (#241–#252) in data/weapon_skills.yaml.

patches.title: Auto Ranged Attack
patches.description: Enables automatic ranged attacks while engaged when a ranged spec (such as DNC Bladewheel) is active.

patches.title: Dnc Ranged Dances
patches.description: Allows Steps and Flourishes to execute at ranged distances up to 20 yalms when Bladewheel is socketed.

patches.title: Eos Jugpet Spells And Skills
patches.description: Configures deterministic spell lists and AI casting cooldowns for Eos and Titania faerie pets.

patches.title: Blm Necromancer Pets
patches.description: Configures custom Undead Warrior, Undead Mage, Corse, and Dullahan pet IDs (130–133) for BLM Necromancer.

patches.title: Search Job Labels
patches.description: Streams active OverlordsXI Soul Crystal spec labels in `/search` and party search results.

patches.title: Talent Ws Unlocks
patches.description: Gates Weaponskill usage until at least 1 Tier-1 Talent Point is invested and adds the `0x1FD` (`OXTL`) binary packet for instant Ashita `/talents` UI syncing.

patches.title: Aoe Healing Affect Pets
patches.description: Allows custom party AoE healing abilities (such as RUN Lifebinder's Sanctified Ward) to affect pets and avatars.

patches.title: Mnk Chiweaver Ranged Chi
patches.description: Enables unarmed ranged Chi bolt auto-attacks (0–20y), custom effects 829–830, and party/pet AoE reach for MNK Chi Weaver.

patches.title: Run Overcharge Effect
patches.description: Registers RUN Spellblade Overcharge Runes custom effect ID 831 cleanly and raises MAX_EFFECTID to 832.

patches.title: Brd Spec Effects
patches.description: Raises MAX_EFFECTID to 840 and registers BRD spec status effects 832–836.

patches.title: Sam Spec Effects
patches.description: Raises MAX_EFFECTID to 848 and registers SAM spec status effects 837–841 (ronin_stagger, imp_drawn_oisoya, imp_cosmic_brand, warlord_noto, warlord_ashura).

patches.title: Bst Alpha Warden
patches.description: Implements Alpha Warden pet enmity forwarding, Master/Pet damage split hooks, and shared recast reduction helpers.

patches.title: Pld Spec Effects
patches.description: Adds PLD Aegis Sentinel/Retribution status effects and Shield Mastery interception hooks.

patches.title: Drk Spec Effects
patches.description: Registers DRK Dreadnought spec status effects for Blood Tithe and Dread Bastion.

patches.title: Nin Kagemusha Spec
patches.description: Implements NIN Kagemusha shadow-break hooks, Kawarimi Ash triggers, and custom spec effects.

patches.title: Blu Spec Effects
patches.description: Registers BLU Azure Carapace spec status effects for Azure Surge and Bastion affinity buffs.

patches.title: Rdm Crimson Duelist
patches.description: Adds RDM Crimson Duelist riposte, Flow weaving, and hex-mitigation C++ engine hooks.

patches.title: Healer Spec Effects
patches.description: Registers status effect IDs for the WHM Bishop, PLD Martyr, BLU Magus, DNC Reveler, SMN Celestial, PUP Mechanist, GEO Arborist, and DRG Lifescale healer crystals.

patches.title: Shared Ox Status Slots
patches.description: Allocates reusable shared OverlordsXI buff and debuff status effect slots (Breach, Cripple, etc.) across all Crystal Specs.

patches.title: Polearm Buckler Equip
patches.description: Allows Warrior Spartan crystal holders to equip Polearms alongside Size-1 Buckler shields.

patches.title: Reduce Recasts Binding
patches.description: Exposes player:reduceRecasts(seconds) Lua binding for spec abilities that shave ally cooldowns.

patches.title: Cor Gambler Effects
patches.description: Adds Corsair Gambler ability-only recast reduction (reduceAbilityRecasts) and Lucky/Roll XI hook support.

patches.title: Blu Set Spell Binding
patches.description: Exposes getBlueMagicSlots Lua bindings so BLU Crystal Specs can grant bonus Blue Magic set points and slots.

patches.title: Talent Packet Dispatch
patches.description: Handles crystal socket change packet dispatch and instant Weaponskill talent sync updates.

patches.title: Talent Ws Gating
patches.description: Enforces Tier-1 Weaponskill Talent gating cleanly in C++ battleutils when inspecting unlocked WSs.

patches.title: Rng Huntsman Pets
patches.description: Configures custom Huntsman pet IDs and subjobs (Wild Raaz, Stalker Raptor, Cehuetzi, Gabbrath) in petutils.cpp for exact-level scaling.
